description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to colors, primarily used for visualizing categories or statuses in a dark-themed dashboard for consistent, high-contrast color coding.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color based on an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a predefined theme color (for known statuses) or generates a deterministic color for unknown statuses, ensuring consistent coloring for various process states.
